description: Store, classify and embed records; manage their prompts
author: Serg Parf

namespace.help: Required non-blank UTF-8 string, 1..128 bytes; no BOM, NUL or newline. Never optional for record operations.

tableName.help: UTF-8 table name, 1..128 bytes; required for upsert/get/prompts, optional filter for list/delete. A table alone is never sufficient.

id.help: Exact record ID, 1..128 UTF-8 bytes; strings only, no numeric coercion.

key1.help: Optional exact filter value, at most 256 UTF-8 bytes; null is refused and never silently omitted.

key2.help: Optional exact filter value, at most 256 UTF-8 bytes; null is refused and never silently omitted.

data.help: UTF-8 source, at most 32768 bytes; no BOM, NUL or invalid encoding. For application/json, supply JSON text.

mime-type.help: Content type; HTML excludes script/style, Markdown keeps its source, JSON is canonicalized for chunking.

embeddings.help: Optional array of vectors, exactly one per deterministic chunk; at most 8 vectors and 8192 total scalars. Each vector has the configured dimensions; finite numbers only, never booleans. Omit to call Voyage.

limit.help: Page size 1..2; at most two canonical records, each at most 256 KiB including vectors and classification results.

cursor.help: Opaque token from a prior list reply with the same filters/limit; expires after 10 minutes and on restart. At most 128 outstanding tokens; no raw backend offset accepted.

action.help: Prompt operation. Requires namespace and tableName. set requires data; get/delete forbid data.

upsert.help: Create or replace one record after classification and embedding succeed
upsert.returns: Canonical record JSON with namespace, tableName, id, optional key1/key2, data, mime-type, embeddings and derived classification_ids (label-to-probability object). At most 256 KiB; no input classification override.

get.help: Read one canonical record, or null when absent

list.help: List canonical records in point-ID order with an opaque continuation token
list.returns: JSON object with records (at most 2) and cursor (string or null); filters never grant access.

delete.help: Delete one record or the exact namespace-scoped selection
delete.returns: JSON status object. id requires tableName. namespace alone explicitly deletes that namespace; missing/blank/null namespace is refused. Unknown outcome is reported, never retried automatically.

prompts.help: Read, set or delete the classification and future summary settings for one table

args.name: data
args.help: For set only: object with labels (1..64 IDs, at most 128 bytes each, mapped to descriptions <=512 bytes), instructions (1..4096 UTF-8 bytes), optional threshold (finite 0..1, default 0.5), top_k (integer 1..64, default 5), summary (<=4096 UTF-8 bytes, stored for R.9). No extra keys; booleans are not numbers.

qdrant.help: Complete Qdrant proxy bus name; this app needs its own write grant

voyage.help: Complete embedding proxy bus name; this app needs its own allow grant

ai.help: Complete Decisions proxy bus name; this app needs its own allow grant

collection.help: Owner-created dedicated collection, 1..64 ASCII letters, digits, underscore or hyphen; never auto-created

embedding_model.help: Fixed embedding model ID, verified against collection metadata.embedding_model

dimensions.help: Fixed unnamed Cosine vector size, 1..8192; chunks times dimensions must not exceed 8192

decision_model.help: Model for one Jev Choice call per record
